name: Phoebe

tierList.prydwen: DPS: T1.5 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes; Hybrid: T2 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Rectifier dual-mode character - switches between Absolution (Main DPS, relies on Spectro Frazzle already on enemies) and Confession (Hybrid, applies/buffs Spectro Frazzle for a partner, currently only Zani) via her Forte 'Prayer' resource (120, refills over 24s).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - O Come Divine Light (3 hits) / Chamuel's Star Basic (3 hits, inside Ring of Mirrors).
skills.resonanceSkill: To Where Light Shines - summons Ring of Mirrors (stagnate + pull), can teleport into it.
skills.forte: Radiant Invocation - at full Prayer, Heavy Attack: Absolution Litany (enters Absolution) or Skill: Utter Confession (enters Confession); both restore Divine Voice for enhanced Starflash Heavy Attacks.
skills.liberation: Dawn of Enlightenment - Spectro hit; +255% DMG in Absolution, applies 8 Spectro Frazzle stacks in Confession.
skills.outro: Attentive Heart - 528.41% ATK Spectro hit (+255% in Absolution) or Silent Prayer buff (10% Spectro RES Shred + 100% Frazzle DMG Amplify) in Confession.

echoSet: Eternal Radiance (100%, best DPS - 10% Spectro DMG + up to 35% conditional)

teams.name: Best Team (Absolution)
teams.notes: Needs a Spectro Frazzle applier (Rover for single-wave, Ciaccona for multi-wave).

teams.name: Best Team (Confession)
teams.notes: Confession Phoebe currently only pairs meaningfully with Zani.

rotation: Absolution: Intro -> Skill: Mirror Summon (+teleport) -> Forte: Absolution Litany (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Chamuel's Star P1-3 (dash-cancel) -> Forte: Starflash (swap-cancel) x4 -> Outro. Confession: same opener into Utter Confession, only 2 Starflash loops before Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: extremely flexible dual-role kit (DPS or Hybrid) and arguably the most F2P-friendly 5-star in the game, but Absolution mode needs Spectro Frazzle re-applied per wave (weak in Whimpering Wastes) and Confession mode is currently a one-trick buffer exclusively for Zani.
